Package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.highlight

Class VideoClip

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.highlight.VideoClip
public final class VideoClip extends Object
The record of a saved clip file: where it lives, how long it runs, what it was recorded at and how much room it takes.

Not the footage, and not a window onto the disk: the domain never asks the file system anything. Whether the file is still there is a question for the layers that already touch files, because the archive keeps the record even after somebody deletes the footage.

  • Constructor Details

    • VideoClip

      public VideoClip(String filePath, int durationSeconds, Resolution resolution, double sizeMb)
      Records a clip under the file name its camera chose. The size is the camera's estimate, never a measurement of the file.
      Parameters:
      filePath - the file the clip belongs in
      durationSeconds - how long the clip runs, at least one second
      resolution - the resolution the clip was recorded at
      sizeMb - the estimated size, in megabytes
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the path is blank, the duration is not positive, the resolution is missing or the size is negative
